metadata.description: RunDrill language-learning courses. Each plugin is one natural-language course: a <subject>-coach skill backed by an MCP drill engine (curriculum, progress, mistake memory).

plugins.name: rundrill-kazakh
plugins.description: Kazakh coach — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Starts at A0 (the alphabet).

plugins.name: rundrill-english
plugins.description: English coach — drills, progress, and mistake memory, for Russian/Kazakh speakers.

plugins.name: rundrill-spanish
plugins.description: Spanish coach (A1–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills grammatical gender, ser/estar, the two pasts, and the subjunctive.

plugins.name: rundrill-french
plugins.description: French coach (A1–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills nasal vowels, passé composé/imparfait, the subjunctive, and y/en.

plugins.name: rundrill-italian
plugins.description: Italian coach (A1–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills gemination, essere/avere, the congiuntivo, and ci/ne.

plugins.name: rundrill-german
plugins.description: German coach (A1–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the four cases, V2/verb-final order, separable verbs, and Konjunktiv II.

plugins.name: rundrill-portuguese
plugins.description: Portuguese coach (A1–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills nasal vowels, ser/estar, the future subjunctive, and clitic placement.

plugins.name: rundrill-dutch
plugins.description: Dutch coach (A1–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills de/het, V2/verb-final order, separable verbs, and hebben/zijn.

plugins.name: rundrill-swedish
plugins.description: Swedish coach (A1–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills en/ett, double definiteness, V2 inversion, and the supine.

plugins.name: rundrill-hungarian
plugins.description: Hungarian coach (A1–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills vowel harmony, ~18 case suffixes, and definite/indefinite conjugation.

plugins.name: rundrill-czech
plugins.description: Czech coach (A1–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the seven cases, animacy, verbal aspect, and second-position clitics.

plugins.name: rundrill-polish
plugins.description: Polish coach (A1–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the seven cases, aspect, the masculine-personal plural, and nasal vowels.

plugins.name: rundrill-greek
plugins.description: Greek coach (A1–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the alphabet, the four cases, no infinitive (να), and verbal aspect.

plugins.name: rundrill-arabic
plugins.description: Arabic coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the abjad, emphatic/pharyngeal sounds, the root-and-pattern system, and the case endings.

plugins.name: rundrill-armenian
plugins.description: Armenian coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the alphabet, ejective consonants, the seven cases, and auxiliary tenses.

plugins.name: rundrill-chinese
plugins.description: Chinese coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the four tones, characters, measure words, and aspect particles.

plugins.name: rundrill-estonian
plugins.description: Estonian coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the fourteen cases, consonant gradation, the partitive, and no future tense.

plugins.name: rundrill-georgian
plugins.description: Georgian coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the script, ejectives, the split-ergative cases, and polypersonal verbs.

plugins.name: rundrill-hebrew
plugins.description: Hebrew coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the alphabet, the root-and-binyan system, verb gender, and the construct state.

plugins.name: rundrill-hindi
plugins.description: Hindi coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills Devanagari, retroflex sounds, the ergative ne, and compound verbs.

plugins.name: rundrill-indonesian
plugins.description: Indonesian coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the affix system, reduplication, classifiers, and no tense marking.

plugins.name: rundrill-japanese
plugins.description: Japanese coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the three scripts, particles, keigo, counters, and conjugation.

plugins.name: rundrill-korean
plugins.description: Korean coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills Hangul, the particles, speech levels and honorifics, and conjugation.

plugins.name: rundrill-latvian
plugins.description: Latvian coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the seven cases, the declensions, tone, and conjugation classes.

plugins.name: rundrill-lithuanian
plugins.description: Lithuanian coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the seven cases, pitch accent, mobile stress, and participles.

plugins.name: rundrill-persian
plugins.description: Persian coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the script, the ezāfe, light verbs, and colloquial-vs-formal diglossia.

plugins.name: rundrill-romanian
plugins.description: Romanian coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the postposed article, the genitive-dative, neuter gender, and the subjunctive.

plugins.name: rundrill-russian
plugins.description: Russian coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the Cyrillic alphabet, the six cases, verbal aspect, and verbs of motion.

plugins.name: rundrill-serbian
plugins.description: Serbian coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills both scripts, the seven cases, pitch accent, and verbal aspect.

plugins.name: rundrill-slovak
plugins.description: Slovak coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the seven cases, the rhythmic-length rule, aspect, and three genders.

plugins.name: rundrill-tagalog
plugins.description: Tagalog coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the focus/trigger system, aspect, the ang/ng/sa markers, and enclitics.

plugins.name: rundrill-thai
plugins.description: Thai coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the five tones, the script, classifiers, and the polite particles.

plugins.name: rundrill-turkish
plugins.description: Turkish coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills vowel harmony, agglutinative suffixes, the cases, and the evidential past.

plugins.name: rundrill-ukrainian
plugins.description: Ukrainian coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the Cyrillic alphabet, the seven cases, verbal aspect, and the vocative.

plugins.name: rundrill-uzbek
plugins.description: Uzbek coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills vowel harmony, agglutinative suffixes, the six cases, and the script split.

plugins.name: rundrill-vietnamese
plugins.description: Vietnamese coach (A0–C2) — drills, progress, and mistake memory. Drills the six tones, classifiers, the kinship-pronoun system, and serial verbs.
